title: feat(app-shell): Delete Behavior row in the Studio field panel on lookup, user and master_detail fields
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbYG8enByZpuMcJGBafucYrK)_

Fixes #29807

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim: 6596731216 (amended 6596763338)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 对象设计器的字段面板(`ObjectFieldInspector`)在 lookup、user 与 master_detail 字段上新增「删除行为」下拉框(`deleteBehavior`)。lookup 与 user 可选 置空 / 级联 / 限制;master_detail 只有 级联 / 限制(规范拒绝在主从字段上写 `set_null`)。首项「— 无 —」把该键从字段定义里删掉。字段改成没有该行的类型时删除该键,改成 master_detail 时删除已写的 `set_null`。
- 为什么改:删除行为决定被引用记录删除时本记录怎么办,在 user 字段上「不声明」本身就是一种生效的结果。此前 Studio 里看不到也设不了,只能改原始元数据。
- 风险与回滚:只动字段面板的类型专属区与类型切换;text、tree 等类型不出现该行(有测试钉住)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` 的 `offeredDeleteBehaviors`(哪种类型给哪些值)、`changeType` 里的 `dropsDeleteBehavior`、`DeleteBehaviorField` 的 `onCommit`(选值写入 / 选「无」走 `unsetDefKey`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.test.tsx`,预期 54 个用例全部通过(其中 9 个是本 PR 新增的删除行为用例)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The Studio object designer's field panel can now set and clear `FieldSchema.deleteBehavior`. Until now only the generic `field` / `object` metadata forms (PR #29712) offered it, and the object editor draws the designer and its inspectors, not those forms.

| Field in the panel | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| `lookup` | picker config, name toggle, related list; no Delete Behavior | a Delete Behavior select: — None —, Set Null, Cascade, Restrict |
| `user` | the name toggle only | the same select with the same four items |
| `master_detail` | picker config, related list | the select with — None —, Cascade, Restrict (the spec refuses an authored `set_null` there) |
| `text`, `tree` and every other type | unchanged | unchanged, no row |

- **Values follow the generic form's rows** (`field.form.ts`): all three on `lookup` and `user`, `cascade` / `restrict` on `master_detail`. One helper, `offeredDeleteBehaviors(type)`, decides both the row and its values.
- **Unset removes the key.** The select leads with the designer's existing "— None —" item, using the inspector's own absent-key convention: `InspectorSelectField`'s `''` option mapped to `unsetDefKey`, the shape the `valueDomain` row already uses. The field then carries no `deleteBehavior` at all, never `''` or `null`. On a `lookup` that means the spec default; on a `user` field it keeps the field out of the delete walk.
- **Retype.** `changeType` now removes `deleteBehavior` when the next type draws no row, `tree` included, and removes an authored `set_null` on a retype to `master_detail`. `cascade` and `restrict` survive a retype to `master_detail`.
- **Wording.** The label, help text and option labels are five new Studio namespace keys (`designer.field.deleteBehavior`, `.help`, `.set_null`, `.cascade`, `.restrict`) in `en` and `zh`, the two locales that namespace carries. The label and help text match the form row; the Cascade and Restrict labels are `field.form.ts`'s `master_detail` option labels.

## Tests

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.test.tsx`, a new top-level describe in the shared harness (9 cases, over the real inspector with a host that feeds each patch back as Studio's draft does):

- The row is drawn on `lookup` and `user` with None plus three values, and on `master_detail` with None plus two.
- CONTROL: no row on a `text` or a `tree` field.
- Picking Cascade on a `user` field writes `deleteBehavior: 'cascade'`.
- Picking None on a `lookup` holding `restrict` leaves the key absent (`hasOwnProperty` false), with `reference` kept.
- A retype from `lookup` to Text drops the key.
- A retype from `lookup` to Master-Detail drops `set_null`, and keeps `cascade`.

Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty, each red:

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| A1 the row's render guard prefixed with `false &&` | 5 failed (the three draw cases, set, unset) |
| A2 the retype's `delete nextDef.deleteBehavior` removed | 2 failed (both retype cases) |

## Acceptance notes

- Surface: exactly the amended claim's five files. `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` (a type helper, `changeType`, the row and its component), its shared test harness, `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts` (five keys each), and `.changeset/29807-field-panel-delete-behavior.md` (patches for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`). The Studio namespace table is a plain string-to-string record outside the locale packs, so the new keys widen no published type and the claim's `Clause-②: no` holds.
- PR #29805 (#29733) does not touch this file; its "— None —" item is private to `SchemaForm`. This row reuses the field panel's own absent-key path instead, so the two PRs share no code (claim amendment 6596763338). #29805 has since merged and is in this branch through the main merge.
- A stored value the type does not offer (an authored `set_null` on a `master_detail`) is drawn flagged by `InspectorSelectField`, as every select in the panel does, so the author sees what the save refuses.
- The help text sits under the select as plain text. `InspectorSelectField` takes no description, so it is not wired as the control's accessible description, unlike the name toggle's checkbox.
- The dead-keys report lists `designer.field.deleteBehavior.` among the dynamic prefixes it keeps alive (3 keys, one call site), the same as `designer.field.summary.fn.`.

## Verification

Real backend (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` in `examples/app-crm`) and the source Console on Vite, as the admin, on head `e646fdc1` (this PR's code is unchanged by the later main merge). Screenshots and scripts are in the project folder `issue-29807/` (`shots/`, `setup.mjs`, `measure.cjs`, `read.mjs`), not on GitHub.

<details><summary>Before, set, publish, unset: the definition carries the key, then drops it</summary>

- A scratch package `com.example.dbx` over REST: `dbx_account`, and `dbx_ticket` with `title` (text), `parent_ticket` (lookup), `assignee` (user) and `account` (master_detail), none declaring the key.
- Before (`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` from `origin/main` swapped in under the same Vite server, then restored to the HEAD blob): no Delete Behavior row on any of the four fields (`before-*.png`).
- After, at `/apps/setup/metadata/object/dbx_ticket`: the row is on `parent_ticket` and `assignee` with — None —, Set Null (clear the reference), Cascade (delete children), Restrict (block the delete), and on `account` with — None —, Cascade, Restrict; `title` has none (`set-*.png`). Picking Cascade, Restrict and Restrict autosaved the draft (`PUT /api/v1/meta/object/dbx_ticket?mode=draft` 200, three times), Publish answered `POST …/dbx_ticket/publish` 200, and `GET /api/v1/meta/object/dbx_ticket` then served `parent_ticket.deleteBehavior` `cascade`, `assignee` `restrict`, `account` `restrict`, and no key on `title`. After a reload the selects read those values (`set-reloaded-*.png`).
- Picking — None — on `parent_ticket` and `assignee`: the last draft PUT body carried neither key on those two fields (`account` kept `restrict`), Publish answered 200, and the served definition had no `deleteBehavior` on `parent_ticket` or `assignee` (`unset-*.png`).

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates and suites</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --commands` derives no tier mandate (default tier). Changed lines 229 (+228 / -1), 5 files.
- On the merged head `eab8960c` (main merged, which brought in PR #29805), after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and a full `pnpm build` (117/117): `turbo run type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` 66/66; 128 test files (all 31 `ObjectFieldInspector*` files, the zh base-term census, `block-config-i18n`, the whole `@object-ui/i18n` package) at 2 workers under the verify lock, 128/128 files, 1800 passed, 13 skipped.
- On `eab8960c`: the derived set, 35 commands, every one exit 0, including `check-sdui-manifest` (manifest intact, 106 components) and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` under the lock (170 files passed, 2 skipped); `--ran` reconciles 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The same set was also all exit 0 on `e646fdc1` before the merge.
- ui `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:spec-symbols` exit 0 on `eab8960c`; `eslint` on the four touched source files exit 0 (warnings only, all on lines this PR does not touch).

</details>
